title: ScanFinder tutorial video script
description: Machine-readable script for tools/video_tutorials/scanfinder_video_runner.py. Times: each step starts when the previous one ends; a step's duration_sec includes its own action time. t=0 is the start of the recording; the first step starts at lead_in_sec.

description.description: One-line summary of what the video teaches.

target_length_sec.description: Advisory — the planned total is derived from the steps.

lead_in_sec.description: Still frames before the first step.

lead_out_sec.description: Still frames after the last step.

window_title.description: Title of the app's MAIN window (exact match preferred, substring accepted; any dash style).

cdp_port.description: Chrome DevTools port for selector targets. DEV app only: npm start -- --remote-debugging-port=9222.

maximize.description: Maximise the main window before recording (recommended: child windows open maximised too).

window.description: Window whose frame is captured in mode=window (default app.window_title).

region.description: [x, y, w, h] screen pixels for mode=region.

target.description: Exactly ONE of selector | rel | abs | image, plus optional window + offset.

selector.description: CSS selector resolved live in the named window over DevTools (dev app only).

rel.description: [fx, fy] fraction of the window's client area.

image.description: PNG of the control, path relative to the script file; pyautogui image search.

window.description: Which app window the selector/rel is in (default app.window_title). Use the exact titles: 'ScanFinder', 'ScanFinder — Review', 'ScanFinder — Search', 'Scan Finder — Settings', 'Teach a new document — Scan Finder'.

offset.description: [dx, dy] pixels added to the resolved point.

wait_for.description: Pre-condition checked before the step's action runs (retries until timeout; not charged to duration_sec).

window.description: A window with this title must exist (native dialogs too, e.g. 'Select the folder of scanned documents to import').

selector.description: This element must be visible in `window`.

narration.description: Spoken line for the later TTS pass. Empty for silent steps. Keep to ~2.5 words per second of duration.

caption.description: Short on-screen phrase (≤ 8 words). Empty hides the overlay for this step.

duration_sec.description: Total time the step occupies, including its own action.

optional.description: If true, a failing action is logged and the run continues.

resolve_timeout.description: Seconds to keep retrying the target lookup (default 8).

text.description: type_text: text to type (target optional — clicks it first).

keys.description: press_keys: one key ('enter', 'escape', 'tab') or a chord (['ctrl', 'f']).

window.description: focus_window: title to bring to front.

timeout.description: focus_window / launch_app: seconds to wait for the window.

wait_for_window.description: launch_app: window title that signals the app is up.
